findings: A saxophone-specific institutional repertoire list identifies the Molenaar edition as Ber Joosen's arrangement for soprano saxophone.

The Philharmonie de Paris digitized 10 ans avec le saxophone identifies Molenaar 06051060, 6 minutes 50 seconds, and movements Allegro, Siciliano, Vivace (3/8). It describes the edition as oboe, clarinet, or soprano saxophone with piano, dated 1965. This is edition evidence, not Telemann's composition date.

Windmusic library's matching entry calls the work Concerto en Fa mineur in its translated title. Exact original-work TWV identity and major/minor labeling require the edition before linking general Telemann concerto recordings.
